summary: Extract the app-independent Effect SDK into the top-level @fractal/sdk workspace package

replay.detail: No claim replay, recovery, projection or persisted-state behavior changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, schema versions or data rewrites change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules, rules digests and fleet coordination requirements are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The @fractal/sdk npm name and effect entry point are unchanged, but its source package moves to packages/fractal-sdk without a forwarding shim. Browser consumers provide the app-local BrowserSt3Platform Layer for page-bootstrap socket adoption and visibility/LRU policy; non-browser consumers supply a collections socket factory and may provide a bearer credential callback. The generated client protocol, authorization rules and existing collections socket remain unchanged; typed descriptors reuse the existing window ingestion pass.

downtime.detail: No daemon startup work or expected service interruption is introduced. Follows continue to share one multiplexed collections socket; this change makes no new latency measurement claim.

manual.detail: Source consumers using the old app-relative package location must use packages/fractal-sdk. Browser applications must inject their platform Layer; non-browser applications must supply a socket factory that honors credential headers. Fractal Web and repository workspace, build and CI references are updated in this change. Operators do not need to migrate state or re-pair clients.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new rollback restrictions; reverting the SDK extraction requires no data migration.
